method: Subjective visual review of the current imported portrait, independent of Battle results. Not an objective or biometric measurement.
rubric: 1–8 scale: 4 average presentation, 5 above average, 6 strong facial balance/definition, 7 exceptional, 8 reserved upper bound. Review facial balance, proportion, apparent symmetry and definition; do not score fame, body, ethnicity or Battle results. Single-photo estimates; lighting, pose, styling and occlusion reduce confidence.
